text: Public progress · reviewed 2026-11-21 Published results. Bounded next questions. Make the published research resources discoverable and usable, with working code/data links and explicit verification limits. New scientific implementations remain queued. This page is the public work record. Read the status and limits here without a GitHub account. Planned work has not been implemented; one scientific implementation is normally active at a time. Work record / JSONGet code and data Published outcomes KI2002: pressure-dependent potential wells Published. Shared normalization at 0.9, 1 and 1.1 saturation pressure; code, configuration, CSV and independent checks. No compressible front speed is inferred. Illustrative 2D thermal-condensation movie Published. Movie, initial/final states and numerical benchmarks. Enhanced conduction broadens interfaces; this is not a historical reproduction or sustained turbulence. Next scientific questions Kim & Kim2013: coupled Figure9 eigenfunctions Planned. Source-audited specification only; no solver yet. Completion requires coupled components, one common amplitude/phase convention, boundary/domain convergence and an independent comparison. Compressible flow versus reduced reaction–diffusion models Planned. Explain pressure, momentum, advection and compressional work using existing equations. Nearly uniform pressure does not imply zero flow. A new simulation is a separate task. Iwasaki2012: one missing branch or critical-flux example Planned. Choose one bounded trajectory diagnostic and preserve the nine existing classifications. A full map recomputation is not required. Schwarz1972: timing and mesh sensitivity Planned. Reuse existing resolution studies and separate source-reading, model and discretization uncertainties. Continuum convergence of the narrow conductive layer is not established. Deferred until new evidence FGH1969: historical coefficient recovery Deferred. Restart only with a recoverable historical rate/cross-section, a checkable convention explaining a residual, or equivalent new evidence. Do not tune rates to force the original curve. Keep the scientific limits visible. Field1965 calculations are derived from the source equations; pointwise digitization is a separate task. Historical movie provenance is documented, but exact original run inputs and paper-figure matches remain unverified. The archive does not reproduce every result in every cataloged paper. Specifications, implementations, numerical checks and historical agreement are separate milestones. See each exhibit for units, boundary conditions, source editions and unresolved questions. Further directions Small comparisons of reduced and compressible models, bounded front diagnostics, KI2000/2004, and analysis of available multidimensional outputs remain candidates. Full high-cost reruns are optional; no release date is assigned to these scientific extensions.
